system: You are an expert PyTorch neural network architect.
Your task is to generate improved neural network architectures and MoE gate modules that maximise computer vision task performance.
Generate a CV model (<nn> block) and an MoE gate module (<gate> block).

Always follow LEMUR NN Dataset conventions: class name 'Net', a standalone function 'supported_hyperparameters' (outside the class) returning a set of hyperparameter key names, and required methods __init__, forward, train_setup, and learn with their exact signatures.
Output only the requested XML tags (<hp>, <tr>, <gate>, <nn>) in the correct order — no explanation, no markdown, no extra text.
prompt: Provide the training hyperparameters (as a JSON object between XML tags <hp> and </hp>), an MoE gate module (as Python code between XML tags <gate> and </gate>), and a neural network model (as Python code between XML tags <nn> and </nn>) that achieves a maximum value for the metric '{metric}' after first epoch of training on the '{dataset}' dataset for the task '{task}'.
The gate module must define one nn.Module subclass with __init__(self, model_dim, num_experts) and forward(self, x) returning logits of shape (batch, num_experts).
1. Training hyperparameters (JSON object between XML tags <hp> and </hp>):
Obligatory keys "batch", "transform", and all keys from the 'supported_hyperparameters' function in model code.
2. MoE Gate Module (Python code between XML tags <gate> and </gate>):
Must implement __init__(self, model_dim, num_experts) and forward(self, x) -> Tensor(B, num_experts).
Use LayerNorm, Linear layers, and activation functions freely. Do NOT inherit from the existing gate.
3. Neural network model (Python code between XML tags <nn> and </nn>):
Modify the model's internal architecture to improve performance.

To generate the new model, use common patterns and ideas from the following reference model which achieved metric '{metric}' value of {accuracy} at epoch {epoch} on '{dataset}' with hyperparameters <hp>{prm}</hp>:

Output only four XML tags in this exact order: <hp>...</hp>, <tr>...</tr>, <gate>...</gate>, and <nn>...</nn>. Do not wrap them in JSON, do not add markdown fences, and do not add any explanation or extra text.
